notes_for_editor: No readable source gives a removal year, a staffing record, notable fires, or what remains at the site today, so those are omitted. Access and visit are omitted because no source gives them. Two of the three sources are catalogs and the survey text is quoted through a fan site, not the NGS original; the NGS original was not read.
